This website gives you finished 3D and motion websites you can build with AI.

A clothing rail you scroll along, a wall of trainers that light up, sunglasses you look through, a shop you walk around, a vending machine, a camper that unfolds, a cider farm and a house move told in one scroll.

Pick a site, download the folder, give it to Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, Replit or ChatGPT and say “Build this site”. Then make it yours: your name, your colours, your products.

Comment SITE and I’ll send you the link.
